narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional collaboration between the Muyao 4 Super Play variety team and Kaohsiung Metro to highlight a unique event. By showcasing the 'one-day' craftsmanship of making food models and involving a popular pet mascot, the content aims to drive visitors to the Zuoying Station exhibition between March and April.
